sentences.en: This is Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 这里是“隐藏的大脑”。

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedanta.
sentences.zh: 我是尚卡尔·韦丹塔。

sentences.en: In the early hours of the morning, when the air is heavy and the ticking clock runs slow,
sentences.zh: 在清晨时分，当空气凝重、时钟走得缓慢时，

sentences.en: Randy Gardner would step out into his yard.
sentences.zh: 兰迪·加德纳会走到院子里。

sentences.en: He would stand beside the giant cactuses he'd planted
sentences.zh: 他会站在自己种下的巨型仙人掌旁，

sentences.en: and listen to the cars that whiz by on Highway 54, which runs behind his home in San Diego.
sentences.zh: 聆听呼啸着驶过他圣迭戈家后方54号公路的汽车。

sentences.en: Standing in the moonlit shadows, he would call out in agony.
sentences.zh: 站在月光下的阴影中，他会痛苦地呼喊。

sentences.en: I would go out in the backyard at 3 in the morning and scream my head off like a wild animal.
sentences.zh: 我会在凌晨3点走到后院，像野兽一样声嘶力竭地尖叫。

sentences.en: Many people are familiar with the suffering Randy experienced.
sentences.zh: 许多人都熟悉兰迪所经历的痛苦。

sentences.en: There's a lonely communion that binds those who plead with the gods at 3 o'clock in the morning.
sentences.zh: 有一种孤独的共鸣，将那些在凌晨3点向神明祈求的人紧紧联系在一起。

sentences.en: No one can help you.
sentences.zh: 没有人能帮你。

sentences.en: No one can make you feel better.
sentences.zh: 没有人能让你感觉好受一点。

sentences.en: No one can do anything.
sentences.zh: 没有人能做任何事。

sentences.en: It's like you're going insane.
sentences.zh: 就像你要疯了一样。

sentences.en: But Randy also knew he was different from everyone else.
sentences.zh: 但兰迪也知道，自己和所有人都不一样。

sentences.en: Many years ago, as a rebellious teenager, he tempted those very same gods.
sentences.zh: 多年前，作为一个叛逆的青少年，他曾向那些神明发出挑战。

sentences.en: His punishment, he understood, was payback.
sentences.zh: 他明白，他的惩罚是付出的代价。

sentences.en: Thank you again.
sentences.zh: 再次谢谢你。

sentences.en: Have a lovely day.
sentences.zh: 祝你度过美好的一天。

sentences.en: I was in San Diego recently for a conference.
sentences.zh: 我最近去圣迭戈参加一个会议。

sentences.en: I had some downtime, so I decided to visit someone I'd been wanting to meet for a long time.
sentences.zh: 我有一些空闲时间，于是决定去拜访一位我久仰大名的人。

sentences.en: Hey!
sentences.zh: 嘿！

sentences.en: You know what?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗？

sentences.en: Are you Randy?
sentences.zh: 你是兰迪吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I'm Randy.
sentences.zh: 对，我是兰迪。

sentences.en: Randy Shankar, it's so nice to meet you.
sentences.zh: 兰迪，我是尚卡尔，很高兴见到你。

sentences.en: Shankar, nice to meet you.
sentences.zh: 尚卡尔，很高兴见到你。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你好吗？

sentences.en: I'm good.
sentences.zh: 我很好。

sentences.en: Randy Gardner greets me in the driveway of his home.
sentences.zh: 兰迪·加德纳在他家的车道上迎接我。

sentences.en: He gives me a warm handshake and a smile.
sentences.zh: 他热情地和我握手，面带微笑。

sentences.en: He's wearing a lemon-colored shirt and sky blue shorts that set off his deep tan.
sentences.zh: 他穿着一件柠檬黄的衬衫和天蓝色的短裤，衬托出他深色的晒黑皮肤。

sentences.en: He exudes Southern California charm.
sentences.zh: 他散发着南加州的魅力。

sentences.en: Man, you live in paradise.
sentences.zh: 天哪，你住在天堂里。

sentences.en: Well, it's okay.
sentences.zh: 嗯，还行吧。

sentences.en: Do you have bad weather events here?
sentences.zh: 你们这里有什么恶劣的天气灾害吗？

sentences.en: We have hotter-than-hell shit.
sentences.zh: 我们有热得要命的鬼天气。

sentences.en: Well, of course.
sentences.zh: 嗯，那是当然。

sentences.en: Randy lives in a small green-and-white house surrounded by sandy brown stucco homes.
sentences.zh: 兰迪住在一栋绿色相间的小房子里，四周都是沙褐色灰泥外墙的住宅。

sentences.en: The backyard is next to a noisy freeway.
sentences.zh: 后院紧挨着一条吵闹的高速公路。

sentences.en: Randy and his wife, Ilona...
sentences.zh: 兰迪和他的妻子伊洛娜……

sentences.en: I have a family nickname of Nona.
sentences.zh: 我有一个家庭昵称叫诺娜。

sentences.en: ...share their place with a 13-year-old Bengal cat, George.
sentences.zh: ……和一只13岁的孟加拉猫乔治一起住在这里。

sentences.en: Sorry, what I meant was Prince George.
sentences.zh: 抱歉，我的意思是乔治王子。

sentences.en: We did not spoil him.
sentences.zh: 我们可没把他惯坏。

sentences.en: He came that way.
sentences.zh: 他生来就是这样。

sentences.en: Randy and Ilona are now retired, which means lots of time to focus on George and their hobbies.
sentences.zh: 兰迪和伊洛娜现在退休了，这意味着有大量时间专注于乔治和他们的爱好。

sentences.en: These are photographs that I took.
sentences.zh: 这些是我拍的照片。

sentences.en: The walls are covered with some of his favorite shots.
sentences.zh: 墙上挂满了他的得意之作。

sentences.en: The Golden Gate in San Francisco.
sentences.zh: 旧金山的金门大桥。

sentences.en: And stacked on the shelves are knick-knacks and toys.
sentences.zh: 架子上堆满了小摆设和玩具。

sentences.en: At one point in the crawl space, I had over 500 puzzles.
sentences.zh: 有一次在狭小的空间里，我有500多个拼图。

sentences.en: Oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪。

sentences.en: Our story really begins in 1963, when Randy moved to San Diego.
sentences.zh: 我们的故事真正始于1963年，当时兰迪搬到了圣迭戈。

sentences.en: He was 17.
sentences.zh: 他当时17岁。

sentences.en: It was the last in a long line of childhood moves.
sentences.zh: 这是他童年时期频繁搬家的最后一次。

sentences.en: I'm the oldest of four siblings in a military family.
sentences.zh: 我是军人家庭四个孩子中的老大。

sentences.en: And my father traveled around, so we were in different places.
sentences.zh: 我父亲到处跑，所以我们去过不同的地方。

sentences.en: Every two years, we lived somewhere else.
sentences.zh: 每隔两年，我们就得搬到别的地方住。

sentences.en: In every town they lived in, Randy entered the science fair.
sentences.zh: 在他们住过的每个小镇，兰迪都会参加科学展。

sentences.en: I was a kind of a science nerd when I was young.
sentences.zh: 我年轻时有点像个科学书呆子。

sentences.en: When we came to this town, San Diego, I thought, boy, it's a big city.
sentences.zh: 当我们来到这个城镇圣迭戈时，我想，天哪，这是一座大城市。

sentences.en: If you wanted to win in San Diego...
sentences.zh: 如果你想在圣迭戈取胜……

sentences.en: Because I always got a first prize.
sentences.zh: 因为我总是拿一等奖。

sentences.en: ...he'd have to pull out all the stops.
sentences.zh: ……他就必须全力以赴。

sentences.en: Number 21 time, and here come the Skyliners, since I don't have you.
sentences.zh: 第21首歌时间，天际线乐队来咯，因为我没有你。

sentences.en: To understand the project he came up with, it's important to know something about the time.
sentences.zh: 要理解他想出的这个项目，了解当时的一些背景很重要。

sentences.en: Rock and roll was changing radio, and it wasn't just the songs that were gaining notice.
sentences.zh: 摇滚乐正在改变广播，受到关注的不仅是歌曲本身。

sentences.en: It was the DJs playing them.
sentences.zh: 还有播放它们的DJ。

sentences.en: The fabulous 40 of 1959.
sentences.zh: 1959年的传奇40强。

sentences.en: You're here for the year, I'm Peter Sert.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收看本年度节目，我是彼得·塞尔特。

sentences.en: One of them was Peter Tripp, a New York City DJ who hosted Your Hits of the Week on WMGM.
sentences.zh: 其中一位是彼得·特里普，纽约市的一名电台DJ，在WMGM主持《你的一周热门》节目。

sentences.en: Peter plays an important part in our story.
sentences.zh: 彼得在我们的故事中扮演着重要角色。

sentences.en: He wanted to stand out in the disc jockey world, and so, in 1959, he came up with a stunt.
sentences.zh: 他想在唱片骑师界脱颖而出，因此在1959年，他想出了一个噱头。

sentences.en: He announced he was going to do a wake-a-thon to raise money for charity.
sentences.zh: 他宣布将举办一场不睡觉马拉松来为慈善事业筹款。

sentences.en: He would go eight days without sleeping and be on display the entire time.
sentences.zh: 他将连续八天不睡觉，并且全程处于公众视线中。

sentences.en: On January 20, 1959, Peter began broadcasting from a small glass studio in the middle of Times Square.
sentences.zh: 1959年1月20日，彼得开始在时代广场中央的一个小型玻璃演播室里进行广播。

sentences.en: Scientists were there to watch.
sentences.zh: 科学家们在一旁观察。

sentences.en: For the next eight days, he hosted a show while fighting off sleep, preening at first, then yawning, eventually hallucinating.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的八天里，他一边强打精神主持节目，起初还很得意，接着打哈欠，最后开始产生幻觉。

sentences.en: One thing he never did?
sentences.zh: 他唯一没做的一件事是什么？

sentences.en: Sleep.
sentences.zh: 睡觉。

sentences.en: Because it was at 7.14 p.m.
sentences.zh: 因为那是7点14分。

sentences.en: on January 28th of 1959, and we played this record after having stayed away for 200 hours.
sentences.zh: 1959年1月28日，我们在坚持了200小时没合眼后播放了这张唱片。

sentences.en: Here are the bell notes, and I've had it.
sentences.zh: 这是钟声提示音，我已经撑不住了。

sentences.en: Peter Stunt invited others.
sentences.zh: 彼得的噱头引得其他人纷纷效仿。

sentences.en: A few months later, a DJ in Honolulu, Tom Rounds, raised the stakes by going 260 hours, more than 10 days, without sleep.
sentences.zh: 几个月后，檀香山的DJ汤姆·朗兹将赌注提高到了260小时，即不睡觉超过10天。

sentences.en: Intentional sleep deprivation was apparently like the ice bucket challenge for DJs in the 1960s.
sentences.zh: 故意剥夺睡眠显然就像20世纪60年代DJ们的冰桶挑战一样流行。

sentences.en: 17-year-old Randy Gardner, looking to make his mark on the science fair in a new city, wasn't impressed by these feats.
sentences.zh: 17岁的兰迪·加德纳渴望在新城市的光学展上崭露头角，他对这些壮举并不感冒。

sentences.en: Eight days without sleep, 10 days without sleep, big deal, he thought.
sentences.zh: 八天不睡觉，十天不睡觉，有什么大不了的，他想。

sentences.en: You don't need a lot of sleep.
sentences.zh: 你不需要那么多睡眠。

sentences.en: You don't need sleep.
sentences.zh: 你根本不需要睡觉。

sentences.en: It was, that was the thinking back in the 60s, and that's the thinking that I had.
sentences.zh: 这就是60年代的想法，也是我当时的看法。

sentences.en: Randy decided to show up the showman.
sentences.zh: 兰迪决定给这个作秀者一点颜色看看。

sentences.en: He decided he was going to go without sleep for 264 hours, exactly 11 days.
sentences.zh: 他决定连续264小时不睡觉，正好是11天。

sentences.en: And when I said, well, let's go 11 days, I wasn't even thinking about any negative things.
sentences.zh: 当我说，好吧，我们干脆撑11天吧，我根本没去想任何负面的事情。

sentences.en: I was thinking, this really isn't that big of a deal.
sentences.zh: 我在想，这其实没什么大不了的。

sentences.en: You know, when it's over, you catch up, you get your sleep, and you go right on by.
sentences.zh: 你知道，结束之后，你补个觉，把觉补回来，然后生活继续。

sentences.en: Even as a teenager, Randy knew that he had a special skill that made him different.
sentences.zh: 即使在青少年时期，兰迪也知道自己有一项与众不同的特殊技能。

sentences.en: I'm a very determined person, and when I get things under my craw, I can't let it go until there's some kind of a solution.
sentences.zh: 我是一个非常有决心的人，当我有了一块心病，如果不找出某种解决方案，我是绝不会罢休的。

sentences.en: He recruited two of his friends.
sentences.zh: 他招募了两个朋友。

sentences.en: Bruce McAllister and Joe Marciano.
sentences.zh: 布鲁斯·麦卡利斯特和乔·马西亚诺。

sentences.en: And asked them to help keep him awake.
sentences.zh: 并请他们帮他保持清醒。

sentences.en: If you're on your own, you're going to succumb.
sentences.zh: 如果你独自一人，你就会坚持不住。

sentences.en: You're going to fall asleep.
sentences.zh: 你会睡着。

sentences.en: Christmas break was coming up, and Randy and his friends decided it was the perfect time to break the world record for going without sleep.
sentences.zh: 圣诞假期就要到了，兰迪和他的朋友们决定这是打破不睡觉世界纪录的最佳时机。

sentences.en: The first two days were easy.
sentences.zh: 前两天很简单。

sentences.en: He stayed away from beds and tried to stand as much as he could.
sentences.zh: 他远离床铺，尽量多站着。

sentences.en: But on day three...
sentences.zh: 但在第三天……

sentences.en: I noticed that in the morning, I was really nauseous.
sentences.zh: 我发现到了早上，我真的开始恶心。

sentences.en: And this went on for just about the entire rest of the experiment.
sentences.zh: 这种情况几乎持续了整个实验的剩余时间。

sentences.en: And that's when I stumbled on eating citrus for some reason.
sentences.zh: 也就是在那时，我不知怎么地偶然发现了吃柑橘类水果的方法。

sentences.en: Tangerines or oranges seemed to take the nausea away.
sentences.zh: 橘子或橙子似乎能消除恶心。

sentences.en: So your friends, of course, were keeping tabs on you, but they weren't actually accompanying you on the experiment.
sentences.zh: 所以你的朋友们当然一直在关注你，但他们并没有真正在实验中一直陪着你。

sentences.en: So what happened?
sentences.zh: 那么后来呢？

sentences.en: Was one of them...
sentences.zh: 他们其中一个人……

sentences.en: Did you have a rotation system where one of them was always up with you?
sentences.zh: 你们有没有轮班制度，确保其中一个人一直陪着你醒着？

sentences.en: That, exactly, it was a rotation system, where one would be with me and the other would be sleeping.
sentences.zh: 对，就是这样，这是一个轮班制，一个人陪着我，另一个人睡觉。

sentences.en: Or if it was in the daytime, they'd both be with me.
sentences.zh: 或者如果是白天，他们俩都会陪着我。

sentences.en: Soon, the stunt was attracting television reporters.
sentences.zh: 很快，这个噱头吸引了电视记者。

sentences.en: And that was a good thing, because that kept me awake.
sentences.zh: 这是件好事，因为这让我保持清醒。

sentences.en: You know, you're dealing with these people and their cameras and their questions.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你要应付这些人以及他们的摄像机和提问。

sentences.en: Did you start to feel like your mental faculties were slipping?
sentences.zh: 你开始觉得你的智力在衰退吗？

sentences.en: That it was harder to answer questions?
sentences.zh: 回答问题变得更难了吗？

sentences.en: It was harder to remember something, to formulate a phrase or a sentence?
sentences.zh: 记住某些事情、组织一个短语或句子变得更难了吗？

sentences.en: That happened pretty soon.
sentences.zh: 这种情况很快就发生了。

sentences.en: That started maybe day four or five, and it just kept going downhill.
sentences.zh: 大约在第四或第五天开始，情况就一路下滑。

sentences.en: I mean, it was crazy, where you couldn't remember things.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这太疯狂了，你什么都记不住。

sentences.en: It was almost like an early Alzheimer's thing, brought on by lack of sleep.
sentences.zh: 这几乎就像是由睡眠不足引起的早期阿尔茨海默症症状。

sentences.en: The hardest hours must have indeed been the early hours of the morning.
sentences.zh: 最艰难的时刻肯定确实是清晨。

sentences.en: That's often when our circadian rhythms are prompting us to be in the deepest sleep, you know, three, four, five o'clock in the morning.
sentences.zh: 那通常是我们的昼夜节律促使我们进入最深睡眠的时候，你知道的，凌晨三、四、五点。

sentences.en: What did you do during those hours?
sentences.zh: 你在那些小时里做了什么？

sentences.en: We just kept moving.
sentences.zh: 我们一直在动。

sentences.en: We always were driving somewhere, and driving somewhere and then walking.
sentences.zh: 我们总是开车去某个地方，开车到某处然后走路。

sentences.en: Most of it involved lots and lots of walking.
sentences.zh: 大部分时间都涉及大量大量的步行。

sentences.en: I played a lot of basketball, shooting the hoops.
sentences.zh: 我打了好多篮球，投篮。

sentences.en: The early hours of the morning were hardeSt.
sentences.zh: 清晨是最艰难的。

sentences.en: Everything was closed.
sentences.zh: 一切都关门了。

sentences.en: Everyone was asleep.
sentences.zh: 所有人都睡着了。

sentences.en: Randy remembers visiting the local jail.
sentences.zh: 兰迪记得自己去过当地的监狱。

sentences.en: Why did he go to the jail?
sentences.zh: 他为什么要去监狱？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: Maybe because it was open at three in the morning.
sentences.zh: 也许是因为它在凌晨三点开门。

sentences.en: We never close.
sentences.zh: 我们永不关门。

sentences.en: A few days into the wake-a-thon, a sleep researcher from Stanford University showed up.
sentences.zh: 不睡觉马拉松进行几天后，一位来自斯坦福大学的睡眠研究员出现了。

sentences.en: His name?
sentences.zh: 他的名字？

sentences.en: William DeMent.
sentences.zh: 威廉·德曼特。

sentences.en: Seriously.
sentences.zh: 说真的。

sentences.en: And he rented a car, a convertible, and we drove around that.
sentences.zh: 他租了一辆车，一辆敞篷车，我们就开着它到处转。

sentences.en: So we had a really good time when Dr. DeMent came down.
sentences.zh: 所以当德曼特博士来的时候，我们过得非常开心。

sentences.en: That really helped me, because that was like a fresh of something different and new to keep me going.
sentences.zh: 这对我真的很有帮助，因为这就像是一股新鲜的、不同寻常的动力，让我坚持下去。

sentences.en: I understand that Dr. DeMent also played a lot of games with you.
sentences.zh: 我知道德门特博士也陪你玩了很多游戏。

sentences.en: He, besides sort of doing sort of psychological tests, he was actually, he actually played various sort of sports with you.
sentences.zh: 除了做各种心理测试，实际上，他还和你一起进行各种体育运动。

sentences.en: Is that right?
sentences.zh: 是这样的吗？

sentences.en: We did a lot of pinball.
sentences.zh: 我们打了很多弹球。

sentences.en: How did you do?
sentences.zh: 你玩得怎么样？

sentences.en: I did good.
sentences.zh: 我玩得很好。

sentences.en: I think I beat him most of the time.
sentences.zh: 我想大部分时间我都赢了他。

sentences.en: Actually, Randy won all the time.
sentences.zh: 事实上，兰迪一直都在赢。

sentences.en: Physically, I didn't have any probleMs.
sentences.zh: 在身体上，我没有任何问题。

sentences.en: Not walking or throwing the basketball around or playing the pinball games.
sentences.zh: 无论是走路、扔篮球还是玩弹球游戏。

sentences.en: But the mental part is what went downhill.
sentences.zh: 但精神状态却开始走下坡路。

sentences.en: The longer I stayed awake, the more irritable I got.
sentences.zh: 我醒着的时间越长，就越容易烦躁。

sentences.en: I had a very short fuse on day 11.
sentences.zh: 到第11天时，我的脾气变得非常火爆。

sentences.en: I remember snapping at reporters right before I was getting ready to go to sleep after 11 days.
sentences.zh: 我记得在经历11天不睡觉准备入睡之前，我对记者发了脾气。

sentences.en: And they were asking me these questions over and over and over.
sentences.zh: 他们一遍又一遍地问我这些问题。

sentences.en: And I was just, I was a brat.
sentences.zh: 我当时就像个乳臭未干的小孩。

sentences.en: On January 8th, 1964, Randy broke the world record for going without sleep.
sentences.zh: 1964年1月8日，兰迪打破了保持不睡觉的世界纪录。

sentences.en: He'd gone 11 days, 264 hours, without drifting off.
sentences.zh: 他坚持了11天，也就是264小时，没有合眼。

sentences.en: There was only one way to celebrate.
sentences.zh: 只有一个方法可以庆祝。

sentences.en: He was whisked off to a naval hospital so researchers could keep an eye on him.
sentences.zh: 他被迅速送到海军医院，以便研究人员能照看他。

sentences.en: And he went to sleep.
sentences.zh: 然后他入睡了。

sentences.en: How long did you sleep?
sentences.zh: 你睡了多久？

sentences.en: I slept just over 14 hours.
sentences.zh: 我刚睡了14个多小时。

sentences.en: I remember, I remember when I woke up, I was groggy, but not any groggier than a normal, normal person.
sentences.zh: 我记得，我记得当我醒来时，我感到昏昏沉沉，但并不比一个普通人更累。

sentences.en: And did you find that over the next several days or weeks, you needed extra sleep?
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几天或几周里，你发现自己需要额外的睡眠吗？

sentences.en: No, not at all.
sentences.zh: 没有，完全不需要。

sentences.en: I went right back to the regular mode and everything was fine.
sentences.zh: 我直接回到了正常的作息，一切都很好。

sentences.en: Strange, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 很奇怪，不是吗？

sentences.en: Randy's sleep project earned him and his friends first place in the 10th annual Greater San Diego Science Fair.
sentences.zh: 兰迪的睡眠项目让他和他的朋友们在第十届大圣迭戈科学展上获得了第一名。

sentences.en: It also ushered in a lifetime of fame.
sentences.zh: 这也开启了他一生的名气。

sentences.en: This is sound from the popular 1960s TV game show, To Tell the Truth.
sentences.zh: 这是20世纪60年代热门电视游戏节目《说实话》的声音。

sentences.en: The show brings together four celebrity panelists.
sentences.zh: 节目汇集了四位名人嘉宾。

sentences.en: Tom Poston, Peggy Cass.
sentences.zh: 汤姆·波斯顿，佩吉·卡斯。

sentences.en: The panelists face three people who all claim to be the same person.
sentences.zh: 嘉宾们面对三个人，他们都声称自己是同一个人。

sentences.en: What is your name, please?
sentences.zh: 请问你的名字是？

sentences.en: My name is Randy Gardner.
sentences.zh: 我叫兰迪·加德纳。

sentences.en: My name is Randy Gardner.
sentences.zh: 我叫兰迪·加德纳。

sentences.en: My name is Randy Gardner.
sentences.zh: 我叫兰迪·加德纳。

sentences.en: The panelists have to guess which one is the real Randy.
sentences.zh: 嘉宾们必须猜出哪一个是真正的兰迪。

sentences.en: The other two are imposters.
sentences.zh: 另外两个是冒名顶替者。

sentences.en: On the show, the real Randy Gardner is number two.
sentences.zh: 在节目中，真正的兰迪·加德纳是二号。

sentences.en: Number two.
sentences.zh: 二号。

sentences.en: How long did you sleep the minute you were through with the 11 days and nights?
sentences.zh: 在你结束这11天11夜的瞬间，你睡了多久？

sentences.en: 14 hours and 43 minutes.
sentences.zh: 14小时43分钟。

sentences.en: He looks like Clark Kent.
sentences.zh: 他看起来像克拉克·肯特。

sentences.en: He wears dark, horn-rimmed glasses.
sentences.zh: 他戴着一副深色黑框眼镜。

sentences.en: His hair swoops to the left.
sentences.zh: 他的头发向左边梳去。

sentences.en: He's soft-spoken and direct when answering questions.
sentences.zh: 他说话温和，回答问题时开门见山。

sentences.en: Most of the panelists figured out that this Randy was the real Randy.
sentences.zh: 大多数嘉宾都看出这个兰迪才是真的。

sentences.en: Kitty, Carlyle.
sentences.zh: 基蒂，卡莱尔。

sentences.en: I voted for number two because he looks too sleepy.
sentences.zh: 我投给二号是因为他看起来太困了。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: It's not too widely spread.
sentences.zh: 票数并不算太分散。

sentences.en: There were three for number two.
sentences.zh: 有三票投给二号。

sentences.en: Over the next decades, Randy Gardner's life took different turns.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几十年里，兰迪·加德纳的人生经历了不同的转折。

sentences.en: He worked in horticulture, took a stab at photography, and finished up his career working as a stock trader.
sentences.zh: 他从事过园艺工作，尝试过摄影，最后以股票交易员的身份结束了自己的职业生涯。

sentences.en: But whatever he did, his teenage accomplishment stayed with him.
sentences.zh: 但无论他做什么，他青少年时期的成就一直伴随着他。

sentences.en: I'm some kind of a Bruce Springsteen in this sleep world.
sentences.zh: 在这个睡眠世界里，我某种程度上就像布鲁斯·斯普林斯汀。

sentences.en: It's a very strange feeling.
sentences.zh: 这是一种非常奇怪的感觉。

sentences.en: The teenage stunt was the gift that kept on giving.
sentences.zh: 这起少年的特技表演是一份不断带来回报的礼物。

sentences.en: But Randy was to find that there can be a downside to fame.
sentences.zh: 但兰迪发现，名气也会有阴暗面。

sentences.en: When we come back, how it all went downhill.
sentences.zh: 当我们回来时，看看这一切是如何走向衰落的。

sentences.en: And everybody thought I was some kind of ass.
sentences.zh: 每个人都觉得我像个混蛋。

sentences.en: Plenty of people have tried to do what Randy Gardner did, go days on end without sleeping.
sentences.zh: 很多人都尝试过兰迪·加德纳做过的事，连续几天不睡觉。

sentences.en: You can find clips of all their adventures on YouTube.
sentences.zh: 你可以在YouTube上找到他们所有冒险经历的片段。

sentences.en: It's Sunday afternoon right now.
sentences.zh: 现在是星期天下午。

sentences.en: And tonight's day one of going without sleep for the next week.
sentences.zh: 今晚是接下来一周不睡觉的第一天。

sentences.en: I'm about to stay up for three days.
sentences.zh: 我马上要熬夜三天。

sentences.en: This is going to be the hardest challenge I've ever done.
sentences.zh: 这将是我做过最艰难的挑战。

sentences.en: But if you're looking to set a new record for going without sleep.
sentences.zh: 但如果你想创造不睡觉的新纪录。

sentences.en: I'm quite struggling.
sentences.zh: 我挣扎得很厉害。

sentences.en: And I don't quite get it.
sentences.zh: 我有点不太明白。

sentences.en: It's only been...
sentences.zh: 才刚刚过去……

sentences.en: You're out of luck.
sentences.zh: 那你可就倒霉了。

sentences.en: The Guinness Book of World Records has eliminated the category, citing the health dangers of severe sleep loss.
sentences.zh: 吉尼斯世界纪录已经取消了这一类别，理由是严重睡眠不足会带来健康危害。

sentences.en: And I think it's important to keep in mind, by the way,
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，我认为记住这一点很重要，

sentences.en: this is UC Berkeley neuroscientist Matthew Walker,
sentences.zh: 这是加州大学伯克利分校的神经科学家马修·沃克说的，

sentences.en: that Guinness does seem to deem it acceptable for a man,
sentences.zh: 吉尼斯似乎确实认为对一个人来说是可接受的，

sentences.en: I believe it was Felix Baumgartner,
sentences.zh: 我记得那是菲利克斯·鲍姆加特纳，

sentences.en: to ascend to the very outer reaches of Earth's atmosphere in a capsule,
sentences.zh: 乘太空舱上升到地球大气层的最外层，

sentences.en: in a spacesuit,
sentences.zh: 穿着宇航服，

sentences.en: get out of that capsule,
sentences.zh: 离开太空舱，

sentences.en: and then free fall back down to Earth,
sentences.zh: 然后自由落体返回地球，

sentences.en: breaking the sound barrier with his body,
sentences.zh: 用他的身体突破音障，

sentences.en: traveling at well over 1,000 kilometers per hour.
sentences.zh: 以远超每小时1000公里的速度飞行。

sentences.en: That's deemed as okay to do.
sentences.zh: 这样做被认为是没问题的。

sentences.en: Sleep deprivation, because of its deathly consequences,
sentences.zh: 而睡眠剥夺，由于其致命的后果，

sentences.en: no longer.
sentences.zh: 则不再被允许。

sentences.en: So I hope that frames the disease-related risk that Guinness rightfully recognizes regarding insufficient sleep.
sentences.zh: 所以我希望这能衬托出吉尼斯对睡眠不足合理认同的与疾病相关的风险。

sentences.en: Matthew Walker calls himself a sleep diplomat.
sentences.zh: 马修·沃克自称为睡眠外交官。

sentences.en: He spent more than 20 years studying the topic,
sentences.zh: 他花了20多年时间研究这个课题，

sentences.en: and he's written a book titled,
sentences.zh: 并且写了一本书，书名叫作，

sentences.en: Why We Sleep.
sentences.zh: 《为什么要睡觉》。

sentences.en: If your idea of being sleep-deprived is days on end without enough rest,
sentences.zh: 如果你对睡眠不足的理解是连续几天没有充足的休息，

sentences.en: Matthew says,
sentences.zh: 马修说，

sentences.en: think again.
sentences.zh: 那就再想想吧。

sentences.en: Even just the smallest amount of insufficient sleep,
sentences.zh: 即使是最少量的睡眠不足，

sentences.en: we see health consequences.
sentences.zh: 我们也能看到对健康的危害。

sentences.en: And I think perhaps one of the best examples of that small perturbation
sentences.zh: 我认为这种微小干扰的最佳例子之一

sentences.en: is one of the largest sleep experiments ever done.
sentences.zh: 也许是有史以来规模最大的睡眠实验之一。

sentences.en: It's been performed on 1.6 billion people.
sentences.zh: 它在16亿人身上进行过。

sentences.en: It happens twice a year,
sentences.zh: 它一年发生两次，

sentences.en: and it continues to happen.
sentences.zh: 并且仍在继续发生。

sentences.en: It's called daylight savings time.
sentences.zh: 它被称为日光节约时间。

sentences.en: And in the spring,
sentences.zh: 而在春天，

sentences.en: when we lose an hour of sleep,
sentences.zh: 当我们失去一个小时的睡眠时，

sentences.en: we see a subsequent 24% increase in heart attacks.
sentences.zh: 心脏病发作率随之增加了24%。

sentences.en: In the fall,
sentences.zh: 在秋天，

sentences.en: when we gain an hour of sleep opportunity,
sentences.zh: 当我们多了一个小时的睡眠机会时，

sentences.en: there is a 21% decrease in heart attacks.
sentences.zh: 心脏病发作率下降了21%。

sentences.en: So that's how fragile our brain and bodies can be
sentences.zh: 所以，对于哪怕仅仅是最小的睡眠波动，

sentences.en: to even just the smallest fluctuations of sleep.
sentences.zh: 我们的大脑和身体也可能会如此脆弱。

sentences.en: So we don't have to go to the Randy Gardner extreme of 11 days.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们不必达到兰迪·加德纳11天的极端情况。

sentences.en: Just one hour of sleep is all that it takes
sentences.zh: 仅仅一个小时的睡眠不足，就足以

sentences.en: to show these types of demonstrable consequences in terms of ill health.
sentences.zh: 在身体健康方面显现出这些明显的后果。

sentences.en: If you do the math,
sentences.zh: 如果你算一下账，

sentences.en: 11 days times 8 recommended hours of sleep a night,
sentences.zh: 11天乘以每晚推荐的8小时睡眠，

sentences.en: that's 88 hours of sleep that Randy missed.
sentences.zh: 那是兰迪缺少的88小时睡眠。

sentences.en: When he finally went to bed,
sentences.zh: 当他终于上床睡觉时，

sentences.en: he slept only 14 hours.
sentences.zh: 他只睡了14个小时。

sentences.en: The human brain is not capable
sentences.zh: 人类的大脑并没有能力

sentences.en: of getting back all of the sleep that it has loSt.
sentences.zh: 补回它所失去的所有睡眠。

sentences.en: So sleep in this regard is not like the bank.
sentences.zh: 因此，从这个意义上说，睡眠不像银行。

sentences.en: You can't accumulate a debt
sentences.zh: 你不能累积债务，

sentences.en: and then pay it off at some later point in time.
sentences.zh: 然后在以后的某个时间点将其偿还。

sentences.en: There isn't a credit system in the brain or the body.
sentences.zh: 大脑或身体中没有信贷系统。

sentences.en: And we can ask, by the way, why?
sentences.zh: 顺便我们可以问一句，为什么？

sentences.en: Why isn't there something like that?
sentences.zh: 为什么没有类似的东西？

sentences.en: Wouldn't that be wonderful?
sentences.zh: 那不是很好吗？

sentences.en: And there is precedent there, fat cells.
sentences.zh: 这其实是有先例的，脂肪细胞。

sentences.en: So there were times in evolution when we would have feasts
sentences.zh: 所以在进化过程中，总会有丰衣足食的时候，

sentences.en: and there were times when there was famine.
sentences.zh: 也会有闹饥荒的时候。

sentences.en: And we designed a system to come up and store that caloric credit
sentences.zh: 我们设计了一个系统来储存这些热量信贷，

sentences.en: and so that we could spend it when there was a debt.
sentences.zh: 以便我们在有债务时可以消耗它们。

sentences.en: There may be a reason our bodies don't do this.
sentences.zh: 我们的身体不这样做可能是有原因的。

sentences.en: The right analogy to sleep might not be eating, but breathing.
sentences.zh: 对睡眠的正确类比可能不是吃东西，而是呼吸。

sentences.en: You can't say, I'll skip today and catch up on my breathing tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 你不能说，我今天不呼吸了，明天把呼吸补回来。

sentences.en: For a long time, Randy simply basked in the celebrity
sentences.zh: 长久以来，兰迪只是沉浸在特技带来的

sentences.en: that his stunt had brought him.
sentences.zh: 名气之中。

sentences.en: He'd found a way to cheat sleep.
sentences.zh: 他找到了愚弄睡眠的方法。

sentences.en: Life was good for him and his wife, Ilona.
sentences.zh: 他和妻子伊洛娜的生活很美满。

sentences.en: The focus of our life is pretty much George.
sentences.zh: 我们生活的重心基本上是乔治。

sentences.en: George the cat, that teenage Bengal.
sentences.zh: 猫咪乔治，那只十几岁的孟加拉猫。

sentences.en: Randy and Ilona love George.
sentences.zh: 兰迪和伊洛娜都很爱乔治。

sentences.en: I don't know much about cats, but apparently Bengals have the personality of a dog.
sentences.zh: 我对猫了解不多，但显然孟加拉猫有着狗的性格。

sentences.en: They fetch a cat that fetches?
sentences.zh: 它们会叼回东西——一只会捡回东西的猫？

sentences.en: Are you serious?
sentences.zh: 你是认真的吗？

sentences.en: He doesn't do it much anymore.
sentences.zh: 他现在不怎么这样做了。

sentences.en: Listening to Randy and Ilona ooze with affection for George is very sweet.
sentences.zh: 听着兰迪和伊洛娜对乔治倾注的喜爱，真是非常温馨。

sentences.en: When I came to visit, Ilona was getting ready to take George to the vet.
sentences.zh: 当我来访时，伊洛娜正准备带乔治去看兽医。

sentences.en: They're very meticulous about his health.
sentences.zh: 他们对他的健康状况非常细心。

sentences.en: That's partly because, a decade ago, there was another cat in Randy and Ilona's life.
sentences.zh: 部分原因是，十年前，兰迪和伊洛娜的生活中曾有另一只猫。

sentences.en: She died of tongue cancer, and I was so upset that the vets didn't catch it
sentences.zh: 她死于舌癌，我当时非常难过，因为兽医没有发现它

sentences.en: that they never looked in her mouth to find this tumor
sentences.zh: 他们从未查看她的口腔来发现这个肿瘤

sentences.en: that they blamed every other thing.
sentences.zh: 他们把所有事情都归咎于其他原因。

sentences.en: And then she died, and I was so wracked with guilt, which is stupid.
sentences.zh: 然后她死了，我充满了负罪感，这很愚蠢。

sentences.en: You know, I would never do that now.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我现在绝不会那样做了。

sentences.en: You have to move forward.
sentences.zh: 你必须向前看。

sentences.en: You can't go back.
sentences.zh: 你不能回头。

sentences.en: But I didn't then, and I think that's what triggered it.
sentences.zh: 但我当时没有，我想这就是引发这一切的原因。

sentences.en: The it Randy's referring to is insomnia.
sentences.zh: 兰迪所指的“它”是失眠。

sentences.en: About 10 years ago, I stopped sleeping.
sentences.zh: 大约10年前，我停止了睡眠。

sentences.en: I could not sleep.
sentences.zh: 我根本睡不着。

sentences.en: I would lay in bed for 5, 6 hours, sleep maybe 15 minutes, then wake up again.
sentences.zh: 我会在床上躺上5、6个小时，也许睡15分钟，然后又醒来。

sentences.en: I kept thinking, well, this will change because it seems to me that eventually,
sentences.zh: 我一直在想，嗯，这会改变的，因为在我看来，最终

sentences.en: if you don't get enough sleep, your body will just say,
sentences.zh: 如果你睡眠不足，你的身体就会说

sentences.en: we're going to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我们要睡觉了。

sentences.en: But it never happened.
sentences.zh: 但这种情况从未发生。

sentences.en: The man who conquered sleep was now begging for a full night's reSt.
sentences.zh: 那个曾征服睡眠的男人，如今却在祈求一个整晚的安眠。

sentences.en: That's why I keep calling this some karmic payback for, you know, my body going,
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我一直把这称为某种因果报应，你知道的，我的身体在说

sentences.en: okay, buddy, yeah, okay, 11 days without sleep, and you know damn well you need sleep?
sentences.zh: 好吧，老兄，是的，好吧，11天不睡觉，你心里很清楚你需要睡眠吗？

sentences.en: Well, let's try this out for size.
sentences.zh: 好吧，让我们来试试这个分量。

sentences.en: Randy says going without sleep changed him.
sentences.zh: 兰迪说不睡觉改变了他。

sentences.en: And everybody thought I was some kind of ass.
sentences.zh: 每个人都觉得我像个混蛋。

sentences.en: What's wrong with Randy?
sentences.zh: 兰迪怎么了？

sentences.en: What an asshole.
sentences.zh: 真是个混蛋。

sentences.en: There's all kinds of ways to go to sleep, they say.
sentences.zh: 他们说，有各种各样的方法可以入睡。

sentences.en: You know, watch television, read a book.
sentences.zh: 你知道，看电视，读本书。

sentences.en: And I'm thinking, you know, if you can't sleep in the first place,
sentences.zh: 而我在想，你知道的，如果你本来就睡不着

sentences.en: reading a book isn't going to put you to sleep.
sentences.zh: 读本书是不会让你睡着的。

sentences.en: I got news for you.
sentences.zh: 我有个消息要告诉你。

sentences.en: I don't know where they came up with that one.
sentences.zh: 我不知道他们是怎么想出这一招的。

sentences.en: Read a book.
sentences.zh: 读本书。

sentences.en: Watch TV.
sentences.zh: 看电视。

sentences.en: Day in and day out, for years on end, Randy began to feel the way he'd felt at the end
sentences.zh: 日复一日，年复一年，兰迪开始感到他在结束时曾有的那种感觉

sentences.en: of his sleep stunt.
sentences.zh: 他的睡眠特技。

sentences.en: Except this time, there were no TV cameras, no reporters, no prizes.
sentences.zh: 除了这一次，没有摄像机，没有记者，没有奖品。

sentences.en: I was awful to be around.
sentences.zh: 跟我在一起让人感到可怕。

sentences.en: Everything upset me.
sentences.zh: 每件事都让我心烦意乱。

sentences.en: It was like a continuation of what I did 50 years ago.
sentences.zh: 这就像是我50年前所做事情的延续。

sentences.en: We don't know what triggered Randy's insomnia,
sentences.zh: 我们不知道是什么引发了兰迪的失眠

sentences.en: but there's some anecdotal evidence that prolonged sleeplessness can really mess up the brain.
sentences.zh: 但有一些轶事证据表明，长期失眠确实会损害大脑。

sentences.en: Remember Peter Tripp, the radio DJ who inspired Randy with his wake-a-thon?
sentences.zh: 还记得彼得·特里普吗，那个用他的耐力挑战激发了兰迪灵感的电台DJ？

sentences.en: Here's psychiatrist Floyd Cornelison, who monitored Peter,
sentences.zh: 这位是精神病学家弗洛伊德·科尼利森，他曾监控过彼得

sentences.en: speaking on the television series Secrets of Sleep.
sentences.zh: 在电视系列节目《睡眠的秘密》中发表讲话。

sentences.en: The man I saw the first morning that he began this,
sentences.zh: 我看到他开始这件事的第一天早上那个男人

sentences.en: when he was waving at everybody through the glass windows
sentences.zh: 当他在玻璃窗后向所有人挥手

sentences.en: and smiling and laughing and joking with us,
sentences.zh: 微笑着，大笑着，跟我们开着玩笑

sentences.en: after the 200 hours had become a changed individual.
sentences.zh: 200个小时后，变成了一个完全不同的人。

sentences.en: In the months that followed, Tripp seemed unable to recover his center of gravity.
sentences.zh: 在随后的几个月里，特里普似乎无法恢复他的重心。

sentences.en: He fought with his boss and lost his job.
sentences.zh: 他与老板争吵并失去了工作。

sentences.en: He ended up as a salesman, drifting from town to town across America.
sentences.zh: 他最终成了一个推销员，在美利坚的各个城镇间漂泊不定。

sentences.en: Those that knew him well were convinced that those eight days without sleep
sentences.zh: 那些了解他的人确信，那八天不睡觉

sentences.en: had left him permanently damaged.
sentences.zh: 给他留下了永久的损害。

sentences.en: So some of that might have been hyperbole.
sentences.zh: 所以其中一些可能有些夸大其词。

sentences.en: Still, Randy thinks what happened to Peter was real,
sentences.zh: 不过，兰迪认为发生在彼得身上的事情是真的

sentences.en: and his age might have been a factor.
sentences.zh: 而他的年龄可能是一个因素。

sentences.en: That's why I don't think you can do this kind of thing
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我认为你不能做这种事

sentences.en: unless you're 17 or in that age group.
sentences.zh: 除非你17岁或处于那个年龄段。

sentences.en: I know I couldn't do it now, and I wouldn't do it now.
sentences.zh: 我知道我现在做不到，我也不会现在做。

sentences.en: Because I have more sense.
sentences.zh: 因为我更有理智了。

sentences.en: After a decade of insomnia in his 60s,
sentences.zh: 在60多岁经历了十年的失眠之后

sentences.en: Randy finally made an uneasy peace with sleep.
sentences.zh: 兰迪终于与睡眠达成了某种不安的妥协。

sentences.en: He's regained the ability to drift off,
sentences.zh: 他重新获得了入睡的能力

sentences.en: but only for about six hours a night.
sentences.zh: 但每晚只能睡大约六个小时。

sentences.en: And it's required sacrifice.
sentences.zh: 而且这需要付出牺牲。

sentences.en: I love drinking tea, and to this day I can't drink tea
sentences.zh: 我喜欢喝茶，直到今天我都不能喝茶

sentences.en: because I'm afraid I won't be able to sleep at night.
sentences.zh: 因为我担心晚上会睡不着。

sentences.en: You have to have sleep.
sentences.zh: 你必须有睡眠。

sentences.en: It's as important as, it's the big three.
sentences.zh: 它和……一样重要，它是三大要素。

sentences.en: I call it the big three.
sentences.zh: 我称之为三大要素。

sentences.en: Water, food, sleep.
sentences.zh: 水，食物，睡眠。

sentences.en: You've got to have them.
sentences.zh: 你必须拥有它们。

sentences.en: All of them.
sentences.zh: 全部都要。

sentences.en: Randy Gardner, the man who conquered sleep,
sentences.zh: 兰迪·加德纳，那个征服了睡眠的男人

sentences.en: now lives in mortal fear of going a night without it.
sentences.zh: 如今活在终有一天会彻夜无眠的恐惧中。

sentences.en: On the next episode of Hidden Brain,
sentences.zh: 在下一期的《隐藏的大脑》中

sentences.en: we're going to dive deeper into the science of sleep
sentences.zh: 我们将与神经科学家马修·沃克一起

sentences.en: with neuroscientist Matthew Walker.
sentences.zh: 深入探讨睡眠科学。

sentences.en: If we didn't need eight hours of sleep
sentences.zh: 如果我们不需要八小时的睡眠

sentences.en: and we could survive on six,
sentences.zh: 并且靠六小时就能存活

sentences.en: Mother Nature would have done away
sentences.zh: 大自然在数百万年前就会抹去

sentences.en: with 25% of our sleep time millions of years ago.
sentences.zh: 我们25%的睡眠时间了。

sentences.en: Because when you think about it,
sentences.zh: 因为仔细想想的话

sentences.en: sleep is an idiotic thing to do.
sentences.zh: 睡觉是一件极其愚蠢的事情。

sentences.en: So if sleep does not provide a remarkable set of benefits,
sentences.zh: 所以，如果睡眠没有提供一套非凡的好处

sentences.en: then it's the biggest mistake
sentences.zh: 那么它就是进化史上

sentences.en: the evolutionary process has ever made.
sentences.zh: 犯下的最大错误。

sentences.en: This episode of Hidden Brain was produced by Parth Shah
sentences.zh: 本期《隐藏的大脑》由帕思·沙制作

sentences.en: and edited by Jenny Schmidt and Tara Boyle.
sentences.zh: 珍妮·施密特和塔拉·博伊尔剪辑。

sentences.en: Our team includes Renee Klar, Raina Cohen, and Maggie Penman.
sentences.zh: 我们的团队包括蕾妮·克拉尔、雷娜·科恩和玛吉·彭曼。

sentences.en: For more Hidden Brain,
sentences.zh: 想收听更多《隐藏的大脑》

sentences.en: please follow us on Facebook, Twitter, and Instagram.
sentences.zh: 请在脸书、推特和照片墙上关注我们。

sentences.en: If you like our show, tell your friends about us
sentences.zh: 如果你喜欢我们的节目，请向你的朋友推荐我们

sentences.en: and make sure you're subscribed to the podcast
sentences.zh: 并确保你订阅了播客

sentences.en: so you don't miss a single episode.
sentences.zh: 这样你就不会错过任何一期节目。

sentences.en: Writing a review on iTunes or other podcast platforms
sentences.zh: 在苹果播客或其他播客平台上写评价

sentences.en: also helps other people find the show.
sentences.zh: 也能帮助其他人找到这个节目。

sentences.en: Thanks so much for making the time to do it.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你们抽出时间来做这件事。

sentences.en: Our unsung hero this week is Susie Cummings.
sentences.zh: 我们本周的无名英雄是苏西·卡明斯。

sentences.en: I spent two weeks trying to track down Randy Gardner,
sentences.zh: 我花了两周时间试图找到兰迪·加德纳

sentences.en: whom I'd interviewed many years ago
sentences.zh: 我多年前曾采访过他

sentences.en: when I was working at the Washington PoSt.
sentences.zh: 当时我在《华盛顿邮报》工作。

sentences.en: I couldn't find his phone number,
sentences.zh: 我找不到他的电话号码

sentences.en: so I reached out to Susie,
sentences.zh: 所以我联系了苏西

sentences.en: and of course, in no time flat,
sentences.zh: 当然，没过多久

sentences.en: she tracked down his number.
sentences.zh: 她就查到了他的号码。

sentences.en: That's what you do
sentences.zh: 这就是你会做的事

sentences.en: if you're a research librarian at NPR.
sentences.zh: 如果你是NPR的研究图书管理员的话。

sentences.en: Thanks, Susie.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，苏西。

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedantham, and this is NPR.
sentences.zh: 我是尚卡尔·韦丹塔姆，这里是NPR。

sentences.en: I hope you sleep well tonight.
sentences.zh: 祝你今晚睡个好觉。

sentences.en: I'll talk to you very soon.
sentences.zh: 我们很快再聊。
